Operations Manual

## Purpose

This page maps the registry pathway. Each stage links to the page that explains how that stage is operationalised. 

## Before REDCap

| Stage | Main action | Procedure |
|---|---|---|
| **Identify and assess** | Find a potential event and decide whether it should proceed | [Identify potential cases](../pre-redcap/identify-assess.qmd) |
| **Abstract and verify** | Extract the required source information and record uncertainties | [Abstract source information](../pre-redcap/abstract-verify.qmd) |

## Working in REDCap

| Stage | Main action | Procedure |
|---|---|---|
| **Create and complete** | Create one authoritative event record and enter the required information | [Create and complete a record](../redcap/create-complete-record.qmd) |
| **Resolve** | Investigate duplicates, missing information and conflicting evidence | [Resolve record queries](../redcap/resolve-record-queries.qmd) |
| **Maintain** | Control access, routine checks and structural database changes | [Maintain the REDCap database](../redcap/database-maintenance.qmd) |
| **Approve the record** | Confirm that the record is ready for analytical use | [Approve a data record](../redcap/approve-data-record.qmd) |

REDCap is the authoritative location for record-level corrections. Data exported from REDCap should *never* be corrected by hand.

## Post-REDCap analytics & publishing

| Stage | Main action | Procedure |
|---|---|---|
| **Authorise the release** | Confirm the reporting period and extract the cumulative REDCap release using Stata | [Authorise a data release](../release/data-release.qmd) |
| **Prepare CVD event outputs** |Run the six-step event extraction, classification and publication pathway  | [CVD events workflow](../post-redcap/cvd-events-workflow.qmd) |
| **Produce CVD mortality outputs** | Run the six-step mortality extraction, classification and publication pathway | [CVD mortality workflow](../post-redcap/mortality-workflow.qmd) |
| **Update public dashboards, tables and downloads** | Use approved public data releases to update website dashboards, tabulations, and download pages | [Post-REDCap overview](../post-redcap/index.qmd) |
| **Produce reports** | Build the monthly rolling update report. Build the annnual report and public health update. Prepare, approve and publish a one-off report | [BNR reporting workflows](../post-redcap/reporting-workflows.qmd) |
| **Review and publish the Info-hub site** | Complete human review, approval and Stata analytical publication, then inspect the Quarto website preview before GitHub deployment | [Review, approve and publish](../release/review-approve-publish.qmd) |
| **Correct a data release** | Update an already public data-release | [Correct or replace a release](../release/correct-release.qmd) |

## Rules that apply throughout

  
- **Stata** performs data preparation, data analytics, data publishing. 
- **Quarto** presents approved public data products. 
- Confidential data, logs and review material are never posted to the public repository.
- Use one identified reporting period and package identity throughout a workflow.
- Successful analysis is not approval, and analytical publication is not website deployment.
- Stop whenever the source, responsibility, result, disclosure status or approval is unclear.

See [BNR user roles](roles-decision-rights.qmd) for responsibility at each stage.
